name: Luna Hotel Baglioni
positioning: Baglioni Hotel Luna: a historic, traditionally Venetian-style hotel a minute from Piazza San Marco, with frescoed rooms and lagoon-view suites
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from St. Mark's Square
Lovers of period Venetian decor, frescoes and Murano glass

facts.text: The hotel is one minute away from Piazza San Marco.
Interiors reflect traditional Venetian style, with period furnishings, frescoed ceilings, Murano glass and bronze accents.
Superior Rooms have original period furniture and original Murano chandeliers.
Superior Rooms include Acqua di Parma bathroom amenities.
The Goldoni Family Suite has a separate living area and two bedrooms.
The Canova Bar serves espresso, pre-dinner aperitivo and original cocktails, plus a selection of light fare.
Hotel experiences include a VIP after-hours tour of the Doge's Palace.
Hotel experiences include a private tour on a Riva boat.
Guests can join an experience to create their own Carnival mask.
Nearby sights include the Bridge of Sighs, the Doge's Palace, Harry's Bar and the Rialto Bridge.
Conde Nast Traveler reports that a private canal makes for a remarkable arrival and departure.
Conde Nast Traveler says breakfast is served in the Salone Marco Polo, entirely frescoed by pupils of Tiepolo.

highlights.text: The Marco Polo Ballroom is surrounded by original 18th-century frescoes.
The Giorgione Terrace Suite has an Altana, a raised wooden terrace overlooking the roofs of the city.
Canal View Rooms let guests gaze down at passing gondolas and the Royal Gardens.
Lagoon-view suites look over the San Marco Basin and San Giorgio Island; the San Giorgio Terrace Suite 2-Bedroom opens onto the hotel's largest terrace.
Santo Mare serves Italian seafood in a fishmonger-inspired setting.

considerations.text: Several room and suite categories look onto the inner courtyard or Venetian streets rather than the canal or lagoon.
WhataHotel notes the historic building has traditional room sizes.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the central Venice location.
